title: Polyvinyl alcohol/organic montmorillonite composite coatings applied to paper-based barrier packaging materials
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43737-43750
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06196B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zheng Cheng, Mei Ning, Xinmei Nong, Naiyu Xiao, Xueqin Zhang, Le Zhong, Honglei Wang, Guojian Chen, Qianbin Mo
High-barrier PVA/OMMT composite coating was successfully prepared and coated onto Kraft paper, and the coated paper showed enhanced water/oil resistance, oxygen barrier, and mechanical properties, making it a paper-based barrier packaging material.
